description: Conversion table (Documentation/BUILD_SYSTEM_CONDENSED.md section 8): status-to-status conversions on the target, owned by skill nodes (owner = customEffectId). Run on hero connects by ConversionTable in row order within each phase (early = with the on-hit status skills, late = after the debt/number skills). requires: target statuses that must be up (live intensity / turns). chance: 'power' = the owner's rank x power. repeatOnCrit: passes on a critical. consume / produce units: a number, 'all', or 'half:<store>' (half the live amount before consuming, at least 1). Poison units are 0.25% max HP. DoTs are queued (they land on the target's next tick).
